L_cap_defense.pair_invariant: Both endpoints are initially free. On first Maker entry Breaker takes the mate; hence the only remaining target cannot complete, including on a final Maker claim. Other claims can spend a free cell; taking a pair endpoint early also blocks the target.
L_cap_defense.scope: Only the five targets contained in the fixed domain; no full-board defense.

restricted_domain.scope: Any win at L_row, or against the stated L_cap policy, must use a target extending outside this fixed domain. Neither full physical state is settled.
